div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Chat on the left. Canvas on the right. Divider drags
The canvas can pop out. Tabs: Architecture, Plan, Tasks, App, Diff
Every box is a real node with a stable id. No second diagram state
React Flow, ELK layout. Dragged positions are kept
Mermaid export is the shareable text view
The canvas is not generated from Mermaid

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mic fills an editable draft. Nothing is sent until Send
Local Whisper by default. OS recognizer as fallback. Zero tokens
Web Speech is not the default: Chrome sends audio to Google,
and it is unreliable in Electron. Cloud transcription is not the default
A ChatGPT plan token does not cover the transcription API
Grey while a phrase is unstable, black when it is final
3 seconds: still listening. 60 seconds: mic off, draft saved
Numbers, times, money, names and negations: amber if unsure,
with alternatives on hover. 'Scratch that' stays as spoken
Optional one-click strike-through. The resolver, after Send,
reads the whole message, including the retraction

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Enter, or the Send button

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One resolve of the whole message
Canvas: Reading your message, then highlight the diff
No model graph while speaking
Echo times, amounts, counts and names in bold

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Readiness in words, never a lone percentage
Needed before building. Everything we know
Say why the total rose or fell, and link those items
Hover lists them. Items that can wait say so

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Composer target. Exactly one

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Enter answers that card
Recommended option is highlighted, never auto-sent
Nothing is accepted on a timer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A message about that box. It does not answer a question

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A visual change for the pointed-at element

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Normal chat routing

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Selection never answers. The question card stays, dimmed,
its option kept, labeled Paused. Each target has its own draft
Focus is captured when typing starts. A new question waits below
After a box message, return to the focused question, with a toast
Lasso or Ctrl+click: the target reads N boxes, one clause each

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Does the text fit this target's type?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Ask once: answer the paused question, or keep it on this box

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: What kind of box message?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Read-only. Source quote and basis. No state change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Replace the interpretation. History: corrected transcription
Dependents update as for any other change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A new user fact supersedes the old one

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A new linked rule. It may open a question

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Show what loses its prerequisite

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Read-only traversal. No tokens
Still works if the model allowance is used up
A real change then waits as a draft

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Correct, or a new decision?
And it is ambiguous

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Preset: I said this, it was misheard

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Preset: I changed my mind
The downstream effect is the same. The history label differs

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Impact preview before anything is applied. No tokens
Which tasks pause, which are not started, which keep running
Apply or Cancel. Apply is a normal revision

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Project stage

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Update the decision and the readiness counts

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Replan the affected tasks. The estimate updates

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Hard or soft holds. Unaffected work continues

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A forward revision, with change or removal tasks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A box can be an actor, feature, workflow step, rule, field,
contract, external service, screen, open question, assumption,
deferred item, today module, task, or edge
The popover shows that type's facts and its quick actions
An open question becomes the focused card
Today describes current code and is not edited in place:
'change this' becomes a planned change linked to that module
A running task is a message to its owner, not to the worker
Per-box history is in the popover and in the main chat

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The box changed while you typed: show both values, then ask
The box was deleted: fall back to General, keep the draft
Two boxes, 'make these the same': ask which value wins
The message names a different box: the exact name wins, and is echoed
Ctrl+Z before Enter is text undo. After apply, it is a forward revision
200 or more nodes: collapse by feature, zoom from system
to features to rules to tasks, plus search and filters

svg.text: Dictation, one composer target, and fixing a box
